faqs.a:
The drilling of any water well and the installation of any water well casing or pump
               by any person within the corporate limits of the city is hereby expressly prohibited
               without the written consent of the city. For any water well not in existence on the
               effective date of this article, the extraction or diversion of water from any such
               water well within the corporate limits of the city by any person is hereby expressly
               prohibited without the written consent of the city. The provisions of this section
               do not apply to water wells constructed by or under the direction of the city.
(Code 1981, § 33-201; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
